dec.n: Sentencia SU-677/17 (emergency health care for migrants without status)
dec.pe: A pregnant woman from Venezuela without legal status in Colombia was refused prenatal care. The Constitutional Court said everyone, with or without papers, has a right to urgent health care, understood broadly.
dec.pi: Seorang perempuan hamil dari Venezuela tanpa status hukum di Kolombia ditolak layanan kehamilan. MK menyatakan setiap orang, berdokumen atau tidak, berhak atas layanan kesehatan darurat yang dipahami secara luas.

dec.pe: A Venezuelan woman with cancer and a sick child were refused treatment in Colombia because they had no papers. The Constitutional Court said emergency care must cover their serious illnesses.
dec.pi: Seorang perempuan Venezuela penderita kanker dan anaknya yang sakit ditolak berobat di Kolombia karena tidak punya dokumen. MK menyatakan layanan darurat harus mencakup penyakit serius mereka.
